inference-overview.title: Inference pipeline: Prefill and Decode
inference-overview.subtitle: Two execution lanes share the same Transformer operator sequence. Prefill builds the KV cache; Decode repeatedly reads and updates it.

components.label: PREFILL · ① Q/K/V projection
components.summary: PREFILL: Q = XW_Q, K = XW_K, V = XW_V. This stage processes 512 token rows in the current step. Prefill produces prompt K/V rows; Decode produces one new K/V row and one query row.

components.label: PREFILL · ② Q × Kᵀ
components.summary: PREFILL: Prefill: full prompt attention; Decode: one query against K cache. This stage processes 512 token rows in the current step. Decode reads the previously retained K/V rows.

components.label: PREFILL · ③ Softmax + mask
components.summary: PREFILL: Prefill applies a causal mask; Decode normalizes over the cached context. This stage processes 512 token rows in the current step.

components.label: PREFILL · ④ Attention × V
components.summary: PREFILL: Mixes value rows using the normalized attention scores. This stage processes 512 token rows in the current step.

components.label: PREFILL · ⑤ O projection
components.summary: PREFILL: Projects the attention result back to model width. This stage processes 512 token rows in the current step.

components.label: PREFILL · ⑥ Feed-forward
components.summary: PREFILL: MLP expansion, activation, and projection back to model width. This stage processes 512 token rows in the current step.

components.label: DECODE · ① Q/K/V projection
components.summary: DECODE: Q = XW_Q, K = XW_K, V = XW_V. This stage processes 1 token row in the current step. Prefill produces prompt K/V rows; Decode produces one new K/V row and one query row.

components.label: DECODE · ② Q × Kᵀ
components.summary: DECODE: Prefill: full prompt attention; Decode: one query against K cache. This stage processes 1 token row in the current step. Decode reads the previously retained K/V rows.

components.label: DECODE · ③ Softmax + mask
components.summary: DECODE: Prefill applies a causal mask; Decode normalizes over the cached context. This stage processes 1 token row in the current step.

components.label: DECODE · ④ Attention × V
components.summary: DECODE: Mixes value rows using the normalized attention scores. This stage processes 1 token row in the current step.

components.label: DECODE · ⑤ O projection
components.summary: DECODE: Projects the attention result back to model width. This stage processes 1 token row in the current step.

components.label: DECODE · ⑥ Feed-forward
components.summary: DECODE: MLP expansion, activation, and projection back to model width. This stage processes 1 token row in the current step.
